extension.summary: Standalone Vidcore movie and TV catalogue
extension.description: Vidcore by Enigma. Browse and search movies, TV shows and popular people with TMDB metadata and saved search history. Explore titles by streaming service using regional TMDB/JustWatch catalogues with automatic country detection. Choose verified playback sources, including Cinejoy and SRStop episode hosts, using blue Vidcore pickers with artwork, synopsis, air date, runtime and rating. Japanese-original titles are filtered from catalogue listings. Clear Vidcore caches from Tools and read the Changelog from the root menu.
extension.news: 1.1.15: Redesigned Settings and Changelog, smoother buttons, consistent custom dialogs, section refresh fixes, and improved API-key editing and country selection.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host any content.
